title: OneCoin – Internet Gold. Cryptocurrency of the New Generation.

asr.full_text: On Earth, the entire human race worships one sacred idol. He reigns over the whole universe. That idol is the golden body. This golden idol despises the will of heaven. Laughed, he changes. He is the law in heaven holy. Thousands of years have passed. Empires, countries and cities have disappeared. But people still worship him and do not even suspect that a new era, virtual gold is found. Gold is the Internet generation! Ladies and gentlemen! New money has appeared in the world! Cryptocurrency is digital money, which is created to solve our online payment problems. Before that time all our online payments pass either banks, or through payment systems. At the same time, we are losing a lot of money paying their services. Cryptocurrency solves this problem. Digital currencies are definitely the future of online payments and the hottest topic of discussion in the financial market this year. And it all started very recently, in 2009, a group of programmers named Satoshi Nakamoto said that a new generation currency was created. The revolutionary digital currency appeared, Bitcoin. Only in a few years, this currency grown in price from 1 cent to $ 1,200. If you acquired Bitcoin in 2010 for the amount of $ 2,000, then today you would be able to sell them for for more than 4 million. Tell me, if you had the opportunity to come back, would you make such a purchase? Do not be upset, we have a shocking news! We have amazing news. A fantastic opportunity has come and each of us can repeat the success of bitcoin. Because a new crypto currency will be released on the market. Which, in a few months of its existence, is already in 10 of the best cryptocurrencies in the world. OneCoin is now in the beginning stage, as it used to be with Bitcoin, and only if we use this situation or not, does it depend on us. We still have a chance to stack the high upon the golden patch on the cryptocurrency market. It will be a little too late, though as the offer of one-coins is restricted. After all, we can only gain two billion! the billion of coins Hurry up, so that you later do not regret the missed opportunity because time is money How will you protect them? Thanks for watching!

textual.observation: The speaker compares an earlier Bitcoin purchase with a stated current sale value, then presents a new cryptocurrency as an opportunity to repeat that success.

evidence.quote: If you acquired Bitcoin in 2010 for the amount of $ 2,000, then today you would be able to sell them for for more than 4 million.
A fantastic opportunity has come and each of us can repeat the success of bitcoin. Because a new crypto currency will be released on the market.

textual.context: The ASR presents the comparison and opportunity claim directly; it does not state a specific purchase mechanism, recipient, or guaranteed outcome.
textual.potential_relevance: The stated prior investment return is linked to an invitation to repeat that success through a newly released cryptocurrency, which may warrant assessment of how a viewer is expected to participate and what conditions apply.
textual.limitations: The source records do not establish that viewers can purchase the cryptocurrency, that any return is guaranteed, or that money is sent to a particular party.

textual.observation: The speaker identifies OneCoin as early-stage, states its supply is restricted, and urges the audience to act quickly to avoid missing the opportunity.

textual.context: The speaker appears to present OneCoin favorably and uses scarcity and urgency language; the records do not specify the action required to obtain coins.
textual.potential_relevance: The claimed early-stage opportunity is paired with a stated supply restriction and a direct urgency request, which may warrant assessment of the participation step and any associated financial conditions.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish the actual supply, availability, price, transaction process, or results for participants.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because the speaker uses Bitcoin's past price increase and a hypothetical $2,000 purchase growing to more than $4 million to promote a new cryptocurrency opportunity. OneCoin is presented as early-stage and limited in availability, followed by an appeal to hurry, creating an urgent promotional pitch. the available video evidence does not specify a purchase procedure, price, recipient, or guaranteed future return.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The speaker moves from a hypothetical Bitcoin purchase and its claimed appreciation to an invitation to pursue a comparable early-stage OneCoin opportunity. The claimed restricted coin supply and urgency reinforce an acquisition-and-appreciation pitch, although no purchase procedure or future return amount is stated.
